description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Invoca is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to deploy and extend its AI agents in customer environments. The role builds integrations with enterprise systems, supports secure and reliable production workflows, and collaborates with customer-facing and technical teams.
Forward Deployed Engineer deploying customer-specific agentic AI, building REST API and MCP integrations, and implementing AI guardrails

Responsibilities:
• Deploy AI solutions: Build, configure, and deploy customer-specific agentic AI based on standardized templates, with a focus on fast time to value
• Build integrations: Build and maintain inbound and outbound integrations with customer systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, or Google Ads, using REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth2
• Build and deploy MCP servers: Help build and deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that expose Invoca's API endpoints as tools for AI models, with clear, context-rich descriptions so LLMs can use them reliably
• Uphold security and governance: Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop checkpoints so AI agents never take destructive actions, like deleting records or spending budget, without proper authorization and review
• Optimize AI-driven workflows: Monitor tool use performance and, with guidance, tune prompt templates and server responses to reduce hallucinations and latency
• Support evaluations and troubleshooting: Help scope and build proofs of concept, troubleshoot issues during onboarding, and escalate to senior FDEs or engineering when needed
• Collaborate across teams: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to keep our platform "AI-ready" and to identify high-impact integrations for customers
• Document and share: Document what you build, contribute to reusable templates and playbooks, and bring customer feedback and gaps back to the team
• Be on site when it counts: Travel to customer sites as needed, up to 50% during implementation

Requirements:
• 0-2 years of experience in a technical role such as software engineering, integrations, solutions engineering, or technical support
• Strong internships, co-ops, or substantial project work count
• A Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• Solid scripting skills to build and maintain the connections that let AI models interact with other software tools, and comfort working in a test-driven (TDD) environment
• Working knowledge of RESTful APIs, webhooks, JSON, and authentication such as OAuth2, ideally with exposure to platforms like Salesforce, Google Ads, Microsoft Dynamics, or Zendesk
• Familiarity with how LLMs and agents handle tool use or function calling, from coursework, internships, or personal projects
• The ability, with guidance, to take a vague business problem ("Help us automate follow-ups") and break it into a clear technical solution
• An empathetic tone, the ability to explain technical concepts in terms of business value, and a habit of proactive status updates

Preferred:
• experience with Workato or a similar integration platform
• a project that uses LLMs, RAG, or agent frameworks
• familiarity with another backend language such as Python or Go
